question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS top_packaging_id,
        p.id AS current_packaging_id,
        p.name AS top_packaging_name,
        p.name AS current_packaging_name,
        1 AS qty_multiplier
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ph.top_packaging_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_packaging_id,
        ph.top_packaging_name,
        cp.name AS current_packaging_name,
        ph.qty_multiplier * pr.qty AS qty_multiplier
    FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = ph.current_packaging_id
    JOIN packaging cp ON cp.id = pr.contains_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT ph.*
    FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
    WHERE ph.current_packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    AND ph.current_packaging_id != ph.top_packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    top_packaging_name AS container_name,
    current_packaging_name AS item_name,
    CAST(SUM(qty_multiplier) AS BIGINT) AS total_quantity
FROM leaf_items
GROUP BY top_packaging_name, current_packaging_name
HAVING SUM(qty_multiplier) > 500
ORDER BY top_packaging_name, current_packaging_name
